uexLocationNotes._meta: Raw-token to UEX Location string, kept separate from 'aliases' (raw-token to in-game DISPLAY name) because display names are not unique - two raw tokens here display as gateway names that repeat across systems, and only the raw token is unique enough to key an unambiguous UEX lookup. Every value here was confirmed against a live UEX snapshot: a terminal exists with that exact Location, and at least one of those terminals carries priced rows.
uexLocationNotes._scope: GATEWAYS THAT EXIST IN GAME ONLY (the owner's ruling, 2026-08-01). Magnus gateway tokens are excluded: no player can stand there, and a token that can never fire is dead weight that reads as real coverage. TERRA WAS BRIEFLY EXCLUDED THE SAME DAY AND RESTORED - the owner corrected it with 'terra gateway does exist in the game, magnus does not', which also explains why UEX carried 21 real terminals at 'Terra Gateway (Stanton)' with priced rows. That UEX evidence was the signal the exclusion was wrong; treat a populated, priced UEX Location as a reason to check before excluding, not as noise. Only the STANTON-SIDE Terra token is here: the Terra-side counterpart (RR_JP_TerraStanton) is still uncaptured and unverifiable, and is not invented.
